overview: The Arcane Surveillance Nexus is the authoritarian heart of Sanctus Seru’s monitoring apparatus, overseeing scrying, divination, and resonance‑tracking operations.
history: Constructed during the consolidation of Seru’s rule.
Arcane arrays were added to track magical signatures across Luclin.
Purity‑screened divination chambers were introduced to prevent corruption.
Praetorian intelligence monitors were integrated to enforce edicts.
hooks: A scrying array detects an unexplained anomaly.
A divination chamber malfunctions, destabilizing purity wards.
A Praetorian intelligence officer requests assistance with a classified edict.
A resonance‑tracking pylon goes dark without explanation.
